integrity: Proof uses exact spectral projectors, explicit finite exhaustive cospectrality witnesses and symbolic trigonometric optimization; independent coordinate-model corroboration. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact unweighted single-excitation adjacency dynamics on five finite Platonic graph skeletons; only antipodal pair suprema are supplied for the four graphs with unique antipodes. Cross-polytope octahedral and cube transfer are attributed to prior literature. Source comparison cannot exclude unindexed equivalent work.
title: Exact antipodal transport and a nonattained dodecahedral fidelity supremum
